description: This file defines an abstract class BaseLoader within the PhpOffice\PhpSpreadsheet\Reader\Ods namespace, which serves as a base for loading ODS spreadsheet data. It manages a Spreadsheet object and a namespace string, and declares an abstract method for reading workbook data from a DOMElement.

classes.name: BaseLoader
classes.description: Abstract class acting as a base for loading ODS spreadsheet data, maintains a reference to a Spreadsheet object and a namespace string, with an abstract method for reading data from a DOMElement.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the Spreadsheet object and namespace string.

methods.name: read
methods.description: Abstract method that must be implemented by subclasses to read workbook data from a DOMElement.
